messages:
maria: quick heads-up — planning to push model-routing tweak (v2.3.1) tonight at 23:00 PST. can owners confirm rollback readiness?
liam: I can be on call for the deploy window. what exactly is the undo path for this change?
anya: undo is a config toggle + route revert, details in the runbook section B.2. small db migration included but it’s backward-compatible.
sam: tagging the runbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/undo-playbook (see ‘route fallback’ steps)
maria: thanks. main checklist i want green: owner present, smoke tests defined, playbook validated, rollback playtested on staging.
liam: owner present ✅
anya: smoke tests — 1) seed traffic to canary (5%) 2) verify 99th latency < 250ms 3) no 5xxs on model-service. I’ll paste the smoke command:
```
# run from deploy machine
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://canary.api.redwood/generate | jq .latency
```
liam: can confirm smoke script works on staging, results trimmed to ~180ms P99 there.
sam: playbook validation: I walked through the revert steps on staging yesterday, toggle + traffic reassign works, no DB rollback needed.
maria: good. two operations questions: who will execute the toggle if we need to undo? and what’s our decision window?
anya: ops will execute toggle (me or liam). decision window = first 30 minutes after ramp to 100% + ongoing checks next hour. if P99 or error rate degrades >2x we flip back.
liam: logging: make sure traces include request tag `route=v2.3.1` so we can slice quickly. ops will monitor trace dashboard.
maria: CI & feature flags: is the flag already seeded to prod?
sam: flag is in prod off. we’ll enable incrementally: 5% at start, 25% after 10m, 100% after 30m if clean.
maria: rollback SLA: aim for flip + traffic reassign < 5 min after decision. that’s our target.
devops-bot: deploy-schedule: planned window 2025-06-12 23:00 PST — approvers: maria, liam, anya — reminder set for 30m pre-window.
liam: I’ll be available 22:30–00:30 PST.
anya: I’ll run the smoke suite at 5% and 25% steps, posting results in this thread.
maria: final go/no-go? I’ll call it at 22:55 after quick runbook walk. if anyone has blockers speak now. :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
sam: no blockers from infra side.
anya: no blockers. all clear.
maria: ok locking in. I’ll post the live roll-forward notes here during the window and call undo if we cross criteria. thanks everyone.
